26f0a94e: ;If ION is defined and null, then set ZTIO to null to indicate
;that this task is to run in the same i/o environment as the
;calling process

7aa97e54: ;If ZTDESC is not defined, set it to the value of DGPGM, PGM
;or 'IRT UNKNOWN OPTION'

db18968e: ;If ZTRTN is not defined, set it to DQ^DGJUTQ if DGPGM or PGM
;are defined, otherwise go to CLOSE and quit

5aebcd11: ;Get the variable name(s) to be saved and call SAVE to save
;them

f45716b1: ;If DGPGM is defined and ZTSAVE('DGPGM') is not defined,
;set ZTSAVE('DGPGM') to null string

90cd8c4c: ;Call ^%ZTLOAD to queue the task, display a message indicating
;whether the task was queued or cancelled, and branch to CLOSE
;if the task was queued or to END if it was cancelled

9bc2f92b: ;Call ^%ZIS to prompt for device and queue type, if the response
;indicates queuing, call QUE, set POP to 1 and go to CLOSE

587a47d3:  .;
 .;If the task has a scheduled time, set Z equal to the timestamp
 .;for when it should run. Calculate the time using the FILEMAN
 .;date conversion utilities YMD and DTC.
